# How many Schengen days do you have left, and when must you leave?

> Free Schengen 90/180 day rule calculator: paste your past stays to see days used and left, the date your allowance returns, the longest trip from a planned entry date and your last permitted exit. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
